scenicChapters.title: A82 Glencoe and Great Glen
scenicChapters.narrative: For 41 km this is A82 Glencoe and Great Glen, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: North Coast 500
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 43 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

a82-glencoe-and-great-glen.story: A one-way ride of 456 km, Glasgow to Inverness - roughly 6 h 15 in the saddle. On the way it passes Loch Lomond, Rannoch Moor, Glencoe and Fort William. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
